quizName:
Hardest Questions in Illinois
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs hurt driving skills. They slow your reaction time, hurt your coordination, reduce alertness, and make it hard to focus.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery and dangerous when wet. You may lose control of your car. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this intersection.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, what should you do?
questions.explanation: When you see an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to get out of their way. Never try to compete with other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has curves.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing with no warning signals, should you slow down, look, and listen?
questions.explanation: If there are no warning devices or only a crossbuck sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains. Only cross when it is safe.

questions.question: When must a driver slow down in a school zone?

options.text: On school days between 6:30 a.m. and 4 p.m., when children are present, and where signs are posted.

questions.correctAnswerText: On school days between 6:30 a.m. and 4 p.m., when children are present, and where signs are posted.
questions.explanation: You must drive 20 mph in a school zone on school days from 6:30 a.m. to 4 p.m., when children are present, and where signs are posted.

questions.question: Must you yield to a pedestrian using a white cane or guide dog?

options.text: Only when the guide dog is leading the person across the street.
Only if a crossing guard is present.

questions.explanation: You must always give the right-of-way to pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes.

questions.question: Must you signal when changing lanes?
questions.explanation: Always use your turn signal when changing lanes.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is turning right and you also need to turn right, what should you do?

options.text: Turn quickly before the truck or bus turns.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning before you turn.
questions.explanation: Do not try to fit your vehicle between a turning truck or bus and the curb. You could crash. Wait for the truck or bus to finish its turn before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: Work zone barriers, drums, cones, and signs are used to:

options.text: Make drivers angry about slow traffic.
Keep traffic away from dangerous work zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep traffic away from dangerous work zones.
questions.explanation: Work zones are dangerous for both workers and drivers. Watch for cones, barrels, signs, large vehicles, and workers in bright vests. They warn you and show you where to go.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing warning lights?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you cannot see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then go when the gates are raised.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates, wait for the tracks to clear, then go when the gates are raised.
questions.explanation: You must stop at railroad crossings with warning signs, lights, or flaggers. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn is allowed here.
You can turn left only after you stop.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn is allowed here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking reserved for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and other roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: You must let pedestrians go first.
Pedestrians must let you go first.
Construction workers must let you go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must let pedestrians go first.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings and must follow traffic signals. Where there is no signal, you must stop for pedestrians in marked or unmarked crosswalks.

questions.question: What is the only way to remove alcohol from the body?
questions.explanation: Only time removes alcohol from your body. Drinking coffee, eating, or taking a shower will not speed this up.

questions.question: To get court supervision for a traffic violation, a minor must appear in court with a parent or legal guardian and attend traffic safety school.
questions.explanation: A driver under 18 who receives court supervision for a traffic violation must appear in court with a parent or legal guardian and attend traffic safety school.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign means stop.

questions.question: A pedestrian starts crossing after the "Don't Walk" signal flashes. They are in the middle of the street when your light turns green. What should you do?

options.text: Proceed if you have the right-of-way.
Proceed if the pedestrian is not in your lane.
Wait until the pedestrian crosses the street before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the pedestrian crosses the street before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a green light, you must let pedestrians cross first. If a pedestrian is crossing, wait until they are completely across the street before you proceed.

questions.question: When an emergency vehicle with sirens and flashing lights approaches you, should you pull to the right and let it pass?
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle approaches with lights and/or sirens, pull to the right side of the road immediately and let it pass.

questions.question: If you must make an emergency stop on an interstate, what should you do?

options.text: Sound your horn at passing cars to get their attention.
Get out of your vehicle and flag down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on an interstate, pull off the road and turn on your emergency flashers. Stay inside your vehicle if you can. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous because of the high speed of traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Increase your speed to reach your destination more quickly.
Increase the volume of your radio.
Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.

questions.correctAnswerText: Find a safe place to park and take a short nap.
questions.explanation: Watch for signs of fatigue while driving, such as struggling to keep your eyes open or drifting from your lane. If you notice these signs, find a safe place to park and rest.

questions.question: If you are getting tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and either get rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and either get rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: To avoid the dangers of tired driving, take breaks every hour during long trips. If possible, share driving with another person so you can rest while they drive.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right, so prepare to let them in safely.

questions.question: If you become tired while driving, what is the best thing to do?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: When tired, stop to rest or change drivers. Fatigue slows your reactions and makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: If you approach a stopped school bus with flashing lights and signal arm extended, what should you do?

options.text: Proceed at 15 mph if no children are present.
Proceed at normal speed, but watch for children.

questions.explanation: When a school bus has flashing lights and arm extended, you must come to a complete stop. Stay stopped until the arm is pulled back and the bus moves. This applies whether you are traveling in the same direction or from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you cannot turn right. The arrow shows the direction that is not allowed.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:
questions.explanation: Lack of sleep is dangerous. Drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces your awareness, and weakens your judgment—just like drugs and alcohol.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic signs and slower speeds in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Right turns are not allowed here.
